levels.title: First Steps
levels.designNote: A small mixed-orientation route field keeps the first exits readable while sharing the center and perimeter corridors.

levels.title: Close Quarters
levels.designNote: Eight short-to-medium routes fill adjacent corridors with offset bends and several early escape choices.

levels.title: Winding Paths
levels.designNote: A compact seven-cell route field mixes nested hooks with longer paths and several coordinated interior bends.

levels.title: The Weave
levels.designNote: A taller packed route composition adds crossing exit dependencies while maintaining distinct, non-touching centerlines.

levels.title: First Challenge
levels.designNote: The densest board combines short pockets and longer irregular paths across the full square footprint.

levels.title: Larger Weave
levels.designNote: A deterministic 10×10 orthogonal grid weave partitions every visible intersection into a distinct winding arrow route (20 routes, authoring seed 13309).

levels.title: The Deep Weave
levels.designNote: A deterministic 12×12 orthogonal grid weave partitions every visible intersection into a distinct winding arrow route (30 routes, authoring seed 14825).
